name: Poisk
about: Poisk (2009-060A), a crewed vehicle (ISS-SO), launched 2009 Nov 10. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (ATT).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2009 Nov 18), held fixed
docked to S26400; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
